description: Suggest that a domain be observed. This is a request, not an instruction: admission follows documented criteria (a connection to the European Union, publicly served machine-readable files) and is decided by the operator. The answer is always 'received' with 'guarantee: none' — it creates no obligation to observe the domain, no timeline, and no assurance that it will be added. A reason is required and is read by a person.

email.description: Reply address. Used to answer the suggestion and nothing else.

reason.description: Why this domain should be observed. Written for a human reader; a sentence or two is enough.

name: suggest_domain
title: Suggest a domain for observation
